title: Open house invitation
description: Invite leads to an open house with date, time and address. Marketing WhatsApp template for real estate agents and developers.
notes: Opt-in matters: only send to leads who asked for listing updates. Mention light refreshments or tours to add a reason to come.

body.text: You are invited! Join us for an open house at *{{address}}* on {{date}} from {{start}} to {{end}}. Tour the property, meet the agent and ask any questions.
